dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: If you think about it... Could this play be a part of a dream?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Fascinating... Dreams tend to exist on a binary — either dark or light, with notes of bitterness or joy... Yet, this dream defies my attempts to understand it.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: With you to guide me, I'm eager to venture further into this place and discover the colors at the heart of this dream.
